WITH combined AS (
  SELECT o.recordvault, o.orderflow, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM riskandmargin r 
  INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.orderflow
),
status_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    orderflow,
    SUM(cnt) as total_count,
    COUNT(*) as num_refs
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY orderflow
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    c.recordvault,
    c.orderflow,
    c.cnt,
    CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / s.total_count as share,
    1.0 / s.num_refs as avg_share,
    CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / s.total_count - 1.0 / s.num_refs as gap
  FROM combined c
  JOIN status_stats s ON c.orderflow = s.orderflow
)
SELECT 
  recordvault,
  orderflow,
  cnt,
  share,
  gap
FROM with_shares
WHERE gap > 0
ORDER BY gap DESC
LIMIT 10
